verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Transaction Data Services return account transaction data, note refresh/sync via 'Data Refresh' endpoints (daily refresh, can be refreshed on demand), and webhooks for change notifications instead of constant polling — supporting a sync pattern. However, there's no explicit documentation of pagination mechanics or a stated history depth (e.g., days/months of history available) in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit pagination parameters/response structure, documented transaction history depth/lookback window, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the sync pattern in practice.
